what: When objects and letters scattered on the board come within 460px of the cursor, they are pushed away up to 380px by (1 − distance/460)^1.6, rotate 30° and grow up to 1.2x (.45s power4.out). Outside the radius they wobble back to their place and tilt with 1.2s elastic.out(1, .35). When the mouse is outside the board, the screen center acts as the cursor, so objects near the center get pushed whenever the board scrolls past.

options.radius: Reach radius (px), default 460 — 260 at widths 767 and below
options.push: Maximum push distance (px), default 380 — 110 if narrow
options.rot: Max rotation angle (deg), default 30 — 12 if narrow
options.grow: Max growth share, default .2 — use .1 if narrow
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Pushed children (object images · text). Tilt given with CSS rotate is kept as the resting angle

note: On phones (no mouse) only a push at screen center scrolls — touch is not blocked

from.where: index.html .formes (the object section under ”Forms follow perspective.”) · index.js formes()
